title: Never clamp to a range read from font data with f32::clamp
rule: When a range comes from font data (fvar axis min/max, OS/2 or head bounds), do not call `f32::clamp`/`Ord::clamp` with it: they panic when min > max, and a malformed font can store an inverted range. Order the bounds first (`lo = min.min(max)`, `hi = min.max(max)`) and clamp with `v.max(lo).min(hi)`, and add a unit test with an inverted range.
rationale: E10.5 (#98): css_values clamped a requested coordinate with `given.clamp(axis.min, axis.max)` on raw fvar values, so a font with min > max panicked on Copy CSS.
